dataset: Street-level crime, outcomes and stop & search
format: JSON REST API (no key required); CSV bulk downloads
questions: How safe is this postcode / street compared with the borough or national average? | What are the most common offence types here (burglary, ASB, drugs, vehicle crime)? | Is crime trending up or down over the last 12-36 months? | Where are the local crime hotspots and what happened to each case (outcomes)?

dataset: Census 2021 (ethnicity, religion, age, household composition, tenure, occupation, qualifications)
format: JSON REST API; also Nomis API (https://www.nomisweb.co.uk/api/v01/help) and CSV bulk
coverage: England & Wales, down to Output Area (~125 households)
update_frequency: Decennial (2021), with mid-year population estimates annually
questions: Who lives in this area - age profile, ethnic groups, religions, languages? | What household types dominate (families, singles, sharers)? | Do residents own or rent, and from whom (social vs private)? | What share of residents are degree-educated or in professional occupations?

dataset: Output Area Classification (OAC 2021) & London Output Area Classification (LOAC) - geodemographic 'pen portraits' such as 'European Enclaves'
questions: What 'type' of neighbourhood is this (e.g. cosmopolitan, suburban family, student area)? | Which other areas in the city are demographically similar?

dataset: Small area model-based income estimates (MSOA) + approximated social grade & qualifications (Census tables TS062/TS067)
format: XLSX/CSV download; JSON/SDMX via Nomis API
update_frequency: Roughly every 2 years (income); per census (social grade)
questions: What is the typical household income here vs the national distribution? | Is this a 'wealthy' or modest-income neighbourhood? | What social grades (AB/C1/C2/DE) dominate?

dataset: English Indices of Multiple Deprivation (IMD 2019)
publisher: MHCLG (Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government)
api: https://opendatacommunities.org/sparql (SPARQL endpoint; IMD as linked data)
coverage: England (LSOA level); separate indices for Wales, Scotland, NI
questions: How deprived is this LSOA relative to all of England (decile 1-10)? | Which deprivation domains drive it - income, employment, education, health, crime, housing, environment?

dataset: Price Paid Data (every residential sale) + UK House Price Index
format: SPARQL / RDF / JSON; monthly CSV bulk; UKHPI at https://landregistry.data.gov.uk/app/ukhpi
licence: Open Government Licence v3 (address fields have extra conditions)
questions: What did properties on this street actually sell for, and when? | How have local prices trended vs borough / national HPI? | What is the price premium of one postcode over a neighbouring one?

dataset: Price Index of Private Rents & private rental market summary statistics
publisher: Office for National Statistics / Valuation Office Agency
questions: What is a typical rent for a 1/2/3-bed here? | How fast are rents rising in this borough?

dataset: Strategic noise mapping Round 4 (2022) - road, rail and airport noise contours (Lden/Lnight)
update_frequency: Every 5 years (EU Environmental Noise Directive rounds)
questions: How loud is road / rail / aircraft noise at this address (day and night)? | Is the property inside an airport noise contour?

dataset: NaPTAN - national register of all public transport access nodes (rail, tube, tram, bus stops)
questions: Which stations and stops are within walking distance of this postcode? | How many distinct transport modes serve the area?

dataset: TfL Unified API - stations, lines, live status/performance, fare zones, journey planning
format: JSON REST API (free key for higher rate limits)
questions: Which travel zone is this postcode in and which lines serve it? | How reliable is each Underground line (delays, closures)? | How long is the commute to central London from here?

dataset: PTAL - Public Transport Accessibility Levels (the 0-6b / 9-band connectivity score CrystalRoof shows as x/9)
questions: How well connected is this exact spot to the public transport network (0-6b scale)? | How does connectivity compare across candidate addresses?

dataset: Food Hygiene Rating Scheme - every food business (restaurants, cafes, pubs, supermarkets, takeaways) with location and hygiene score
coverage: England, Wales & Northern Ireland (Scotland via FHIS)
questions: What restaurants, cafes, pubs and food shops are nearby? | How hygienic are they (0-5 rating)? | How 'foodie' vs residential is the area (density of venues)?

dataset: NHS Organisation Data Service - GP practices, pharmacies, hospitals with locations
questions: Which GP surgeries and pharmacies serve this postcode? | How far is the nearest A&E or hospital?

dataset: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API - supermarkets, convenience stores, bars, nightclubs, churches, fire/ambulance stations (also used to flag noise sources)
questions: What amenities of any type are within X metres (gyms, parks, nurseries, nightclubs)? | Are there late-night venues, churches with bells, or emergency stations likely to cause noise nearby?

dataset: Get Information about Schools (GIAS) - register of all schools with type, gender, admissions policy, capacity, coordinates
questions: Which schools are nearest, and are they state/faith/independent, mixed or single-sex? | What is each school's admission policy and capacity?

dataset: Ofsted inspection outcomes (management information, monthly)
api: CSV/ODS monthly files on GOV.UK (machine-readable downloads); joinable to GIAS by URN
questions: What is each local school's latest Ofsted judgement and inspection date? | Are ratings in the catchment improving or declining?

dataset: School performance tables (KS2 results, Progress 8, Attainment 8, A-level) + Explore Education Statistics
questions: How do local schools' exam results and pupil progress compare? | Which nearby secondary has the best Progress 8 score?

dataset: Defra UK-AIR modelled background pollution maps (annual NO2, PM10, PM2.5 on 1km grid) + monitoring network
api: https://uk-air.defra.gov.uk/data/pcm-data (CSV per pollutant-year); monitoring API via https://uk-air.defra.gov.uk/data/
format: CSV (1km grid squares); SOS API for monitors
questions: What are annual mean NO2 / PM10 / PM2.5 levels at this location? | Does the area meet UK/EU/WHO air quality limits?

dataset: London Air Quality Network - measured pollutant data from monitoring sites (the source CrystalRoof cites for London air quality)
questions: What is the measured air quality at the nearest monitoring station right now / historically? | How many high-pollution days does this part of London get?

dataset: Risk of Flooding from Rivers and Sea + Risk of Flooding from Surface Water (likelihood categories: very low to high)
api: https://environment.data.gov.uk/dataset/bad20199-6d39-4aad-8564-26a46778fd94 (WMS/WFS + SHP via Defra Data Services Platform); real-time: https://environment.data.gov.uk/flood-monitoring/doc/reference
format: OGC WMS/WFS, Shapefile; JSON REST (real-time warnings, no key)
questions: What is this property's long-term flood likelihood from rivers/sea and surface water? | Are there active flood warnings or high river levels nearby right now?

dataset: ONS Postcode Directory (ONSPD/NSPL) + Open Geography Portal boundaries - maps every postcode to coordinates, LSOA/MSOA, ward, borough (CrystalRoof's 'Royal Mail' postcode layer, in open form)
api: https://api.postcodes.io/postcodes/{postcode} (free JSON lookup built on ONSPD); ArcGIS REST services on geoportal.statistics.gov.uk
format: JSON REST API (no key); CSV bulk; ArcGIS REST/GeoJSON boundaries
licence: Open Government Licence v3 (postcode data contains Royal Mail/OS derived IP with permitted use)
questions: Which LSOA, ward, borough, constituency and region is a postcode in? | What are the coordinates of a postcode (to join all the other datasets)? | Which statistical area should each census/IMD/crime figure be read from?

dataset: Energy Performance Certificates (EPC) - energy rating, floor area, property type for most dwellings
questions: What is a property's energy rating, size (m2) and heating type? | How energy-efficient is the housing stock on this street?

dataset: Ofcom Connected Nations - broadband speeds & mobile coverage per postcode
api: https://api.ofcom.org.uk/ (broadband & mobile coverage APIs, free key); postcode CSV bulk downloads
questions: What broadband speeds (superfast/gigabit) are available at this postcode? | How good is 4G/5G coverage by operator?

dataset: INSPIRE Index Polygons — freehold title boundaries (the shape of the plot)
licence: Open Government Licence v3 (INSPIRE end-user licence)
questions: What is the actual plot boundary and land area of this property? | Does the garden extend where the listing photo implies? | Is there a separate title (garage, strip of land) attached or missing?

dataset: CCOD / OCOD — UK company and overseas-company property ownership
licence: Free for non-commercial use; commercial licence available
questions: Who owns the freehold — a person, a company, or an offshore entity? | Is a single landlord or developer accumulating property on this street? | Is the block owned by a company with a poor track record?

dataset: Companies House — company profiles, officers, filings, charges
questions: Is the freeholder / managing agent / developer solvent and who runs it? | How many other buildings does this landlord control? | Does the management company file accounts on time (a proxy for how a block is run)?

dataset: Council Tax valuation bands (per-property band A–H) and VOA band statistics
questions: What council tax band is this property, and what will the annual bill be? | How does the band mix of a street compare with neighbouring streets (a cheap proxy for property size/value)?

dataset: Council tax levels set by local authorities (Band D charge by council & parish)
api: CSV/ODS releases on GOV.UK; joinable by local authority code
questions: How much more council tax will I pay if I move one borough over? | Which councils give the lowest Band D charge in my search area?

dataset: Planning Data platform — conservation areas, green belt, Article 4 directions, tree preservation orders, listed-building outlines, flood zones, brownfield sites
questions: Is this property in a conservation area or green belt, or covered by an Article 4 direction? | Will I be able to add an extension, replace windows, or install solar panels? | Are there protected trees on or beside the plot?

dataset: National Heritage List for England — listed buildings, scheduled monuments, parks & gardens, World Heritage Sites
questions: Is the building listed (Grade I/II*/II), and what does that restrict? | Are there heritage assets adjacent that constrain nearby development — or protect the view?

dataset: Planning applications aggregated from every UK local authority register
publisher: PlanIt (open aggregator of LA planning portals)
format: JSON REST API (fair use; commercial terms for heavy use)
licence: Source records are OGL LA data; aggregator has its own terms
questions: What is being built next door or on that empty plot? | Has the property itself had extensions approved or refused? | Is a tower block, HMO conversion, or development site proposed within 500m?

dataset: BGS GeoSure (subsidence, shrink–swell clay, landslide, soluble rocks) and Radon Potential
format: WMS/WFS map services (free viewing); licensed data for detailed use
licence: Open viewing under BGS OpenGeoscience; commercial licence for full datasets
questions: Is this on shrink–swell clay likely to cause subsidence in dry summers? | Is the property in a high radon-potential area (radon test / mitigation needed)? | Is there landslide or sinkhole susceptibility here?

dataset: Mining Reporting Areas and coal mining hazards
questions: Will a coal mining search be required for this purchase? | Is the property over historic workings, shafts, or at risk of mine-gas / ground movement?

dataset: Bus Open Data Service — timetables (TransXChange/GTFS), fares and real-time vehicle positions
questions: How frequent is the bus service from this street, and at what times? | Can I reach the station/school by public transport before 8am?

dataset: Rail Data Marketplace / Darwin — timetables, live departures, station facilities
api: https://raildata.org.uk/ (Darwin Lite / Live Departure Boards, free registration)
licence: Free for registered users (National Rail terms)
questions: How long is the train commute from this station and how reliable is it? | How many direct trains per hour to the city centre at peak?

dataset: Journey Time Statistics — modelled travel time to schools, GPs, hospitals, food stores, town centres by mode (LSOA level)
api: CSV/ODS bulk on GOV.UK, keyed by LSOA
questions: How long does it take to reach a hospital, secondary school or supermarket from here — by car, bus, bike and on foot? | Is this area service-accessible or car-dependent?

dataset: STATS19 road safety data — every reported injury collision with coordinates, severity, casualties
api: CSV bulk (annual); also queryable via https://www.crashmap.co.uk/ and the R package stats19
questions: How dangerous is the road outside — collisions, pedestrian and cyclist casualties? | Is the school-run route a known accident cluster?

dataset: National Chargepoint Registry — public EV charge points with location, speed and connector type
questions: Can I charge an EV near this property without a driveway? | How many rapid chargers are within 1km?

dataset: CQC ratings and locations — GP practices, dentists, hospitals, care homes
questions: Is the nearest GP practice rated Good or Outstanding — and is it accepting patients? | What is the quality of local care homes (relevant for later-life or family moves)?

dataset: Ofsted childcare providers register — nurseries, pre-schools and childminders with inspection outcomes
api: CSV/ODS monthly management information on GOV.UK
questions: What nursery and childminder capacity exists within a pram-push of this address? | How are local early-years providers rated?

dataset: OS Data Hub — OS Places (address/UPRN lookup), OS Open UPRN, OS Open Names, OS NGD features
format: JSON REST APIs; open datasets as CSV/GeoPackage/vector tiles
licence: OS OpenData (OGL) for open products; premium plan for Places/NGD
questions: What is the canonical address and UPRN for this property (the key that joins EPC, planning and council records)? | What buildings, roads, paths and greenspace surround the plot?

dataset: OS Open Greenspace + Natural England green infrastructure / access to greenspace
questions: How far is the nearest park, playing field or playground, and how big is it? | Does this address meet Natural England's accessible-greenspace standards?

dataset: MAGIC / Defra designations — National Parks, AONBs (National Landscapes), SSSIs, ancient woodland, agricultural land classification
questions: Is this inside a National Park or National Landscape (stricter planning, protected views)? | Is protected habitat adjacent that will stop development — or guarantee the outlook stays green?

dataset: Active Places Power — gyms, swimming pools, pitches, tennis courts with facility detail
questions: Is there a pool, gym or pitch within walking distance, and is it public or private? | How well provisioned is this area for sport compared with the national average?

dataset: Live for-sale / to-let listings — not open data. Practical routes: PropertyData, Patma, Nestoria API, or portal partner feeds (Rightmove/Zoopla/OnTheMarket require commercial agreements)
licence: Commercial — check terms; scraping portals breaches their T&Cs
questions: What is actually on the market right now matching my criteria? | What is the asking-price-to-sold-price gap in this postcode? | How long has this property been listed and has the price been cut?
